skill.displayName: US Stock Market NYSE NASDAQ DOW
skill.summary: Get US stock market data (NYSE, NASDAQ, and major indices) via FinanceAgent on OneKey Gateway.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the US Stock Market NYSE/NASDAQ/DOW skill.
- Provides US stock market data (including NYSE, NASDAQ, and major indices) through the OneKey Gateway.
- Requires a OneKey Gateway API key for access.
- Supports querying multiple stock symbols using standard US tickers.
- Offers CLI and HTTP example commands for easy integration.
